comment: Known-routine entries of src/10-helpers-msvc-routines.wat. Each is matched on its WHOLE body: 16 head bytes, an FNV-1a over the body with the absolute in-body addresses (jump tables, jmp [table+r*4] operands) left out, and each of those equal to entry + rel. `node tools/kr-sig.js wat` regenerates the WAT signature block from these reference bodies; `node tools/kr-sig.js find --root=DIR` counts them across a corpus. impl names the native form: entries with the same impl share it (and differ only in bytes that cannot change the exit state). k is the length of the body's first instruction, the fallback's resume offset.

entries.name: memcpy
entries.differs: the three-byte up lead does `add esi,1 / add edi,1` where msvc6 has `inc esi / inc edi`; a CMP overwrites the flags right after, so the exit state is the same function of the inputs

entries.name: strcmp
entries.differs: the VC4-6 body (H2DEMOW.EXE) increments with inc; a different entry if ever weighted
